column1: # *** THREE PRINTED TESTIMONIALS FROM MARIST BROTHERS, ST JOSEPH'S COLLEGE, BELMONT PARK, RONDEBOSCH ***
# Supplied by David on 8 October 2026 as photographs of a photocopied album page. The figures are
# handwritten on a photocopy and SOME DIGITS ARE NOT CERTAIN - each row says which.
# The images are not yet in site/public/docs/; the facts are recorded here, which is this archive's
# standard practice and does not depend on the scan.

column7: *** The earliest of the three. *** The hundreds digit of 608 is the least certain figure on this certificate; the other two totals are clear. *** HE BEAT HIS OPPONENT BY 30 *** and the form's best was 690.

*** Dated five days before his twelfth birthday *** - Nuno Fernando was born 6 October 1924. *** He beat his opponent by 43 ***, and the highest in the form was 523. The totals are lower across the board than June's, which is what a shorter term looks like rather than a worse one.

*** The closest of the three: seven marks in it. *** And the form's highest, 1045, is far above his 715 - so whoever was top that term was a long way ahead of both of them. The reading of 715 is the least certain of this row's three figures.
